name: Filestack
line: Upload, transform, and deliver files through APIs and automated workflows.

free.text: 500 uploads, 1K transforms; 1 GB storage/bandwidth; 20 MB/file; no idle pause

cells.regions: US East storage by default; bring your own S3 elsewhere
cells.selfhost: No, hosted file API and storage

sql.math: Filestack is a file API, not a database
Filestack is a file API, not a database

files.math: The Scale plan includes 350 GB of storage, 125,000 uploads and 400 GB of bandwidth. 100 GB stored, 100,000 uploads and 100 GB out fit within those amounts.

jobs.math: Scale workflow executions (runs) cost $0.015 each. A generic job does not clearly match one workflow run, so the cost is unknown.
